newsitem.title: USA: Nationwide Insurance criticized by US Sen. D'Amato.
newsitem.headline: Nationwide Insurance criticized by US Sen. D'Amato.

text.p: Sen. Alfonse D'Amato, R-New York, criticized Nationwide Insurance for deciding to curtail writing homeowners' policies in New York and other eastern states.
"A policy which amounts to redlining the entire east coast of the United States is wrong and unacceptable," D'Amato, the chairman of the Senate Banking Committee, said in a statement.

"A decision to write no new new policies may be a business decision which some feel is warranted. However, under no circumstances should existing policies be terminated and existing policy holders be left without continued coverage."
